d:
Man ambe ki pavan aarti 'aarti ambe gauri ki ' ka bhaktimay gayan sunen. anup jalota aur dipa joshi ke madhur svaron men man durga ki yah divy aarti bhakton ko mata rani ki bhakti aur kripa se jorti hai.
Man ambe ki aarti ka shravan evan gayan kar mata rani ka aashirvad prapt karen.
jay mata di!
Singer: Anup Jalota, Deepa Joshi
Devi Aarti: Aarti Ambe Gauri Ki
Singer: Anup Jalota, Deepa Joshi
Music Director: Tarun Bathre
Lyricist: Tarun Bathre
